summary: Pono Capital Four, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K to disclose the issuance of an unsecured promissory note of up to $100,000 to its sponsor, Mehana Capital LLC, to fund costs related to a future business combination. The note bears no interest, is due upon completion of an initial business combination, and repayment is limited to trust-account funds if no deal occurs. This is a routine working capital facility, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are present. The filing is a standard SPAC interim financing disclosure; no actionable special situation.
